items.title: Trade Desk Stock Tumbles as Things Go From Bad to Worse. Here Come the Downgrades.
items.summary: Trade Desk  stock slumped 20% in early trading Friday after the advertising technology company reported second-quarter revenue that fell short of expectations.  The company reported adjusted earnings of 34 cents a share and revenue of $715 million, up 3% from a year ago.  Analysts tracked by FactSet expected adjusted earnings of 18 cents a share and revenue of $752.6 million.
